description_en: Updates a live stream recording configuration that saves the output to Object Storage Service (OSS)
description_zh: 更新配置APP录制，输出内容保存到OSS中
kebab_example: aliyun live update-live-app-record-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --oss-endpoint learn.developer.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLiveAppRecordConfig

parameters.help_en: The AppName of the live stream
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The endpoint for OSS storage. You must create an OSS bucket before using this feature. See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Endpoint名称。

直播录制文件存储至OSS，需提前创建OSS Bucket，创建方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The recording start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time).

This parameter is only effective for stream-level recordings (i.e., when `StreamName` is specified). The time must be within 7 days of the actual stream start time
parameters.help_zh: 录制开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 设置的时间必须是实际推流时间开始7天之内，只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The recording end time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time).

This parameter is only effective for stream-level recordings. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 7 days
parameters.help_zh: 录制结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 EndTime与StartTime相差不应超过7天，超过7天将按照7天计算。只在流级别录制（StreamName不为空）有效
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the recording mode. Valid values:

0: disables on-demand recording.

1: On-demand recording via HTTP callback.

2: On-demand recording by parsing parameters in the ingest URL.

7: Manual recording. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html API to manually start or stop recording.

If you set OnDemand to 1, you need to call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html API to configure the OnDemandUrl parameter. Otherwise, ApsaraVideo Live does not perform on-demand recording
parameters.help_zh:
按需录制。取值：

0：关闭。
1：通过HTTP回调方式。
2：解析推流参数按需录制。
7：默认不录制，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847882.html接口手动控制录制开启或停止。

当OnDemand取值为1时，需要先通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847891.html接口配置OnDemandUrl，否则默认不录制
parameters.name: on_demand

parameters.help_en: The window in seconds for merging fragmented recording after an interruption. If a stream disconnects and reconnects within this window, the recording will continue in the same file. Valid values: 15 to 21600
parameters.help_zh:
断流拼接时长。
直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持15~21600秒
parameters.name: delay_time

fields.help_en:
The duration of a single recording cycle in seconds. If not specified, the default value is 6 hours

If a live stream is interrupted during a recording cycle but resumes normal streaming within the merge window, recording will continue in the same file. A recording file is generated only when a live stream is interrupted for longer than the merge window
fields.help_zh:
周期录制时长。单位：秒。不填则默认为6小时。

如果在一个录制周期内，直播流发生了断流，但是在断流拼接时长内，该直播流又正常推流，那么仍会在同一个录制文件中继续录制。
一条直播流必须断流超过断流拼接时长，才会生成录制文件
fields.name: cycle_duration

fields.help_en:
The recording format. Valid values:

<notice>

If you choose m3u8 or cmaf, you must also set SliceOssObjectPrefix and SliceDuration. At least one of RecordFormat or TranscodeRecordFormat must be specified.

</notice>

m3u8

flv

mp4

cmaf
fields.help_zh:
格式。目前支持M3U8、FLV、MP4、CMAF。取值：

<notice>RecordFormat和TranscodeRecordFormat两者至少需要设置一个。如果选择m3u8或cmaf格式，必须同时设置请求参数RecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix和RecordFormat.N.SliceDuration。
</notice>

m3u8。
flv。
mp4。
cmaf
fields.name: format

fields.help_en:
The duration of a single segment. Unit: seconds

This parameter takes effect only if you set the RecordFormat.N.Format parameter to m3u8 or cmaf.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 30 seconds is used. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长。单位：秒。

<notice>当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才有效。
</notice>

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en: The transcoded stream recording cycle. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 6 hours is used
fields.help_zh: 转码流录制周期录制时长。单位：秒。不填则默认为6小时
fields.name: cycle_duration

fields.help_en:
The format of the transcoded stream recording. Valid values:

If you choose m3u8 or cmaf, you must specify the TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix and TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceDuration parameters.

m3u8

flv

mp4

cmaf
fields.help_zh:
转码流录制格式。目前支持M3U8、FLV、MP4、CMAF。取值：
<notice>这如果选择m3u8或cmaf格式，必须同时设置请求参数TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceOssObjectPrefix和TranscodeRecordFormat.N.SliceDuration。
</notice>

m3u8。
flv。
mp4。
cmaf
fields.name: format

fields.help_en:
The duration of a single segment for transcoded stream recording. Unit: seconds.

This parameter takes effect only if you set the TranscodeRecordFormat.N.Format parameter to m3u8 or cmaf.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 30 seconds is used. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
转码流录制单个切片时长，单位：秒。

<notice>当TranscodeRecordFormat.N.Format（转码流录制格式）设为m3u8或cmaf时，本参数才生效。
</notice>

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

parameters.help_zh: 转码流录制的转码模板组
parameters.name: transcode_templates
